overview: The MPS School Committee met to review district updates, security protocols, and student assessment data, as well as approve the 2022–2023 school calendar and operating budget. The committee approved a $68,994,776 operating budget for FY 2023, along with a revised dress code policy and a resolution supporting state healthy school lunch legislation.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent presented district updates recognizing student achievements, spring athletic accomplishments, summer programs, and upcoming end-of-year ceremonies.

items.title: CPAC End-of-Year Report
items.summary: The Special Education Parent Advisory Council presented its annual report, after which the committee voted to refer policy concerns regarding incident reports and disciplinary referrals to subcommittees.

items.title: Approval of 2022–2023 District Calendar
items.summary: The committee approved the 2022–2023 district calendar with start and end times added and a notation that elementary Wednesday dismissal times remain to be determined.

items.title: MPS Security Protocol Update
items.summary: District administrators outlined school safety protocols and threat assessment procedures, and the committee voted to receive and place the report on file.

items.title: Implementation Update on NWEA MAP Assessment
items.summary: District leaders and curriculum directors presented student growth data and implementation feedback from the first full year of NWEA MAP testing.

items.title: FY 2023 Operating Budget Update and Approval
items.summary: The committee approved the FY 2023 district operating budget of $68,994,776 as presented.

items.title: Dress Code Policy Second Reading
items.summary: The committee waived the reading and granted final approval to the updated district dress code policy.

items.title: Resolution Supporting Healthy School Lunch Legislation
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution endorsing state legislation relative to healthy school lunches.
